query:
-- Governor races
SELECT 'governor' as chamber, state_name, dem_candidate as c1_name, 'D' as c1_party, rep_candidate as c2_name, 'R' as c2_party, rating
FROM governor_races
WHERE dem_candidate IS NOT NULL AND rep_candidate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rating;

-- Competitive House races (Toss-up, Lean D, Lean R, Likely D, Likely R)
SELECT 'house' as chamber, CONCAT(state_code, '-', district_number) as state_name, 
  candidate1_name as c1_name, candidate1_party as c1_party, 
  candidate2_name as c2_name, candidate2_party as c2_party, rating
FROM house_races
WHERE candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
  AND rating IN ('Toss-up', 'Lean D', 'Lean R', 'Likely D', 'Likely R')
ORDER BY rating, state_code;
